honors.title: Vanderbilt CS Immersion Showcase -- 3rd Place
honors.description: Among 44 projects that were judged, Postcard won 3rd place in the Vanderbilt CS Immersion Showcase sponsored by FortyAU.

projects.title: Postcard
projects.description: Postcard is a social travel platform built for the Vanderbilt CS Senior Immersion Project that transforms travel memories into organized, shareable knowledge. Users capture experiences as photo-based postcards with ratings and reviews, group them into trips, and organize everything into folders — creating both personal archives and community guides. Built around trust, the app combines social discovery, AI-powered itinerary planning, and a community Q&A so that a friend's recommendation carries more weight than an anonymous star rating. The project was built with React Native (Expo), Express + TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
